title: Motion by fmr SriLankan Airlines CEO alleging threats by bribery commission to be considered on March 19
byline: A motion filed on behalf of former SriLankan Airlines Chief Executive Officer Kapila Chandrasena, alleging that officials of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption exerted pressure on him while recording his statement, was fixed to be considered before the permanent Chief Magistrate of the Colombo Chief Magistrate’s Court on March 19, the date on which the related case is scheduled to be taken up.

title: US offers up to $10m reward for information on Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei
byline: US State Dept website also lists four other officials, including the IRGC commander and secretary of defence council

title: US wiped out ‘every military target’ on Iran’s critical oil export hub Kharg Island, Trump says
byline: President Donald Trump said Friday the US military had heavily bombed targets on Iran’s Kharg Island, which handles almost all of Iran’s crude exports, and he threatened to hit the island’s oil infrastructure.

title: Air fares soar amidst Middle East war
byline: Air ticket prices in Sri Lanka are expected to see an increase in the near future, driven by the rising costs of aviation fuel in the global market.

title: Tea auction holds firm as buyers shrug off Middle East uncertainty
byline: Auction No. 10 that concluded was the second auction following the recent tension in the Middle East and notwithstanding the speculation of adverse repercussions vis-à-vis the overall demand/prices at the auctions – there was good general demand, with only the Tippy teas declining substantially and at times being unsellable.

title: EDB convenes meeting with major export sector associations amid Middle East crisis
byline: The Export Development Board (EDB) recently held a high-level meeting to discuss the critical issues faced by the exporters of major products to the Middle East market, due to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East region.

title: How is Sri Lanka responding to the Israel–Iran conflict: Day 15
byline: As tensions escalate between Israel and Iran, Sri Lanka has taken a series of diplomatic, aviation and precautionary measures to manage potential fallout and safeguard its citizens. Here is how Sri Lanka is responding.

title: Lanka IOC assures public of stable fuel supply
byline: Lanka IOC said today that the country’s fuel supply is in safe hands and reassured the public of continued availability.

title: IMF team to visit Sri Lanka for sixth tranche review
byline: A team of representatives from the International Monetary Fund is scheduled to visit Sri Lanka later this month for review discussions ahead of the sixth tranche of the country’s Extended Fund Facility programme.

title: Ibbankatuwa solar power project suspended
byline: The proposed solar power project in an 18-acre area of Dambulla Ibbankatuwa tank has been suspended pending further feasibility study.

title: Sri Lanka needs a new procurement law: MP
byline: Whilst highlighting that there are many issues pertaining to government procurement, Opposition MP Harsha de Silva yesterday said the country needs a new procurement law.

title: Drug menace must be treated as national priority: PM
byline: Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya said that addressing the country’s growing drug problem must be treated as a national priority and should deliver tangible results at the ground level.

title: Government assures to issue auspicious timing with consultation of astrologers
byline: Amidst controversy over finalising the auspicious timing designated for performing Sinhala New Year rituals, Cabinet Spokesman and Minister Nalinda Jayatissa yesterday assured that the government will take steps to issue the auspicious timing with the consultation of the astrologers.

title: US embassy in Iraq’s Baghdad hit in missiles attack, security sources say
byline: The U.S. ​Embassy in ‌the Iraqi capital Baghdad ​was ​hit in a ⁠missiles ​attack, Iraqi ​security sources told Reuters on ​Saturday.

title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles as US-South Korea hold military drills
byline: North Korea has fired multiple ballistic missiles from its west coast as the United States and South Korean forces stage their annual military exercises, according to Japanese and South Korean defence forces.

title: Ministry warns against online classes for children aged 3–5
byline: The Ministry of Women and Child Affairs has urged parents and other relevant parties to refrain from conducting online education classes for children between the ages of three and five.

title: Breaking Down the Israel–Iran Conflict: What We Know So Far - Day 15
byline: This guide answers the most important questions about the Israel Iran war that is unfolding right now. The United States and Israel have launched major military strikes on Iran and Iran has responded with missile attacks across the region. This is one of the most serious escalations in the Middle East in years.

title: Iran, Sri Lanka discuss rescue of crew after US strike on ship
byline: Iran’s Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi has discussed US and Israeli “military aggression” during a phone call with Sri Lankan Foreign Minister Vijitha Herath.

title: Over 120,000 suspects arrested in nationwide anti-drug operation
byline: A total of 120,752 suspects have been arrested during the nationwide drug prevention operation carried out from October 30, 2025, to March 12, 2026, Police said.

title: Trump threatens to hit Kharg Island oil network,  Iran signals defiance
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump threatened to strike the oil infrastructure of Iran’s Kharg Island hub ​unless Tehran stopped attacking vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, a warning that could further roil markets coping with a historic supply disruption.

title: Nearly 3,000 student nurses recruited
byline: A total of 2,918 students were recruited for nursing training with the aim of strengthening the country’s health workforce and improving the quality of healthcare services.

title: Iran warns UAE over US ‘hideouts’ after Kharg Island strike
byline: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has warned the United Arab Emirates that locations used by the United States could become “legitimate targets” following US strikes on Iran’s Kharg Island.

title: 150 investigators appointed to probe misconduct in state institutions
byline: A new pool of 150 investigative officers has been created to strengthen the investigation of misconduct in government institutions, the Ministry of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government announced.

title: Heavy evening showers forecast for next 36 hours
byline: The Meteorology Department has forecast showers and thundershowers in several parts of the country during the next 36 hours, with fairly heavy rainfall expected in some areas.
